image_description: A close-up shot of a small, white weasel (likely an ermine in winter coat) peeking out from a mossy, earthy burrow or crevice. The animal has pure white fur, a distinct black-tipped nose, and dark eyes. Its body is partially visible, appearing slender and elongated as it curves into the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, exhibiting the characteristic triangular shape and pointed snout typical of mustelids.
Both eyes are visible, small, round, and dark, matching the biological description.
Ears are visible on the sides of the head, appearing short and rounded, consistent with weasel anatomy.
